findings.issue: The phase desired outcome says the golden render matches the reference in screenshots of every tab at desktop and 400 px. P2.5's own filed return reports defects it did not fix. The Graph, Deployment and Trust SVGs are clipped on the right at 1440 px (svg.style.minWidth = max(980, w*0.6) forces horizontal scroll with no fit-to-width; the same pattern is at :780 for ER and :943 for sequences). At 400 px the Graph tab opens on a mostly blank canvas, and the sequence diagrams show only the first 3 lifelines. The screenshot script passes with these present because it only asserts console errors and requests, not layout.
findings.resolution: Add a follow-up viewer task before sign-off: fit-to-width or a scale control for the graph, deployment, trust, ER and sequence figures, plus initial scroll or viewBox that shows the diagram at 400 px. Re-run tests/visual/screenshots.py and look at the PNGs.

findings.issue: Turning the Issues switch off while the Issues tab is active hides the Issues panel and its nav tab (viewer.css:338 hides .issues-only) but does not leave the tab. curTab stays 'issues', so the page shows a blank content area until the user finds another tab.
findings.resolution: In the change handler, when the switch is unchecked and curTab === 'issues', call showTab('graph').

findings.issue: viewRole picks deployment and trust views by regex on view id and title (/trust|boundar/, /deploy|release|topolog|infra/) because the model schema has no view kind (schema/archmap-model.schema.json:212-221). The task said 'from model.views' and left open how a view is marked deployment or trust. A graph view titled e.g. 'Infrastructure API' or 'Release notes service' is silently moved out of the Graph tab. The synthesizer that writes views has no documented contract for this.
findings.resolution: Add an optional, additive 'kind' (graph|deployment|trust) to the view definition in the schema and design section 5, keep the regex only as a fallback, and have the synthesizer set it.

findings.issue: The failure path of the visual check was never exercised: the executor says it ran no negative test, so exit 1 on a console error, page error or external request is unproven. Only console messages of type 'error' are collected, so warnings never fail it. No shared-mode render is covered, although shared is one of the three modes the phase builds.
findings.resolution: Run the script once against a render with an injected console.error and an external request and confirm exit 1. Consider adding the shared build to build().
